claims: As of April 2026, Amazon has reached a new agreement with the U.S. Postal Service (USPS).
The agreement ensures USPS retains about 80% of its existing Amazon delivery volume.
The agreement ensures USPS retains over 1 billion packages annually.
Amazon is investing $4 billion to speed up rural deliveries.
Amazon frequently utilizes USPS for the final delivery leg to homes.
Reports indicate USPS delivered roughly 1.7 billion packages annually for Amazon.
The Amazon-USPS partnership began around 2013 with Sunday delivery services.
